title: Roles
description: What each role grants and where it can be bound: the roles part of plat5.yml.

roles.title: roles
roles.description: Map of slug → role. At least one role.

creator_role.title: creator_role
creator_role.description: Required. What the creator of a node gets on it. Bindable at every kind.

permissions.title: permissions
permissions.description: `[a-z0-9:._-]+`, max 64 chars, unique, max 64 permissions. `["*"]` grants every permission; `*` is valid only alone. Each must be required by some route, or be a kind's `list_permission`.

includes.title: includes
includes.description: Other roles whose permissions this one grants too, transitively. Only permissions are included: `bindable_at` stays the role's own.

bindable_at.title: bindable_at
bindable_at.description: Required. The kinds this role can be bound at.
